title: 第一卷 第25章 虐杀秦寒霜千影林第一卷 第26章 宫主帮我我要炸了
content_zh:
随着秦逸的声音响起。
秦寒霜冷哼一声：“狂妄！”
话音落下，秦寒霜瞬间冲上了生死台。
紧接着，一条散发出绚烂光芒的七彩绸带，环绕着她的身体快速转动。
这是上品灵器，攻防兼备。
秦寒霜身上，那股属于中品银丹四重的力量，也在瞬间就已爆发了出来，比起刚才的梁百尺，强的可不是一星半点。
“你以为你杀了梁百尺，就能击败我，取我性命？”
“梁百尺在我眼里，亦不过是一个废物罢了。”
“你也仅仅只是比废物，强了一点。”
秦逸嗤笑一声，道：“如果你死在我手里，那岂不是意味着，你连废物也不如？”
“不知死活的玩意！”
秦寒霜冷喝，下一刻，她结印的双手，猛然朝着秦逸打去。
那条七彩绸带，宛若化作了一条七彩灵河倾泻，速度惊人。
秦逸一步踏出。
身似惊雷而去，他不闪不避，直接迎着那条七彩灵河猛冲。
雷霆万钧！
圆满层次的雷霆剑意，缭绕在剑锋之中。
秦逸一剑切入了这条七彩灵光长河内。
嗤拉！
秦寒霜的七彩灵绸，都被秦逸这一剑，从中间直接劈开。

秦寒霜脸色剧变。
她如此强大的一招，竟就这么被秦逸化解，而且她的灵器也毁了。
眼看着秦逸依旧还在极速冲来。
秦寒霜一咬牙，便祭出了第二件灵器，一块盾牌从她的储物戒中飞出，迎风暴涨，盾牌眨眼间就犹如一座小山那般，挡在了秦逸的面前。
祭出盾牌之后，秦寒霜的双手十指，便拉出了无数的残影，以惊人的速度结印。
只要盾牌能抵挡秦逸片刻，她就能施展出一套杀伤力极强的秘术。
“轰！”
可秦寒霜万万想不到，她祭出的那一面如同小山般的盾牌，也在瞬间就被秦逸的剑给劈炸了！
不等秦寒霜准备施展的术法蓄势完成，秦逸便已经持剑冲到了她的面前。
秦寒霜只能匆忙间挥动双手，一片片光芒从她的指尖洒落而出，但这一片片光芒皆形同虚设，在秦逸的剑锋前宛如薄纸。
秦逸的剑锋唰的一声落下。
“啊！”
秦寒霜便发出一声惨叫，她的胸口被劈开了，鲜血喷溅，她的身体往后倒飞。
秦逸速度更快，追击而去，剑锋直刺。
“噗！”
一剑洞穿了秦寒霜的腹部。
秦寒霜再度惨叫。
content_en:
As Qin Yi's voice sounded.
Qin Hanshuang snorted: "Arrogant!"
As soon as the words fell, Qin Hanshuang rushed to the stage of life and death.
Immediately afterwards, a colorful silk ribbon emitting brilliant light quickly rotated around her body.
This is a top-grade spiritual weapon, capable of both offense and defense.
Qin Hanshuang's power belonging to the fourth level of the middle-grade silver elixir burst out in an instant. It was not even a bit stronger than Liang Baichi just now.
"Do you think you can defeat me and take my life by killing Liang Baichi?"
"In my eyes, Liang Baichi is nothing more than a waste."
"You're just a little better than trash."
Qin Yi sneered and said: "If you die in my hands, doesn't it mean that you are worse than trash?"
"You don't know how to live or die!"
Qin Hanshuang shouted coldly, and the next moment, her sealed hands suddenly hit Qin Yi.
That colorful ribbon seemed to turn into a colorful spiritual river pouring down at an astonishing speed.
Qin Yi took one step forward.
He rushed away like thunder, without dodging or avoiding, and rushed directly towards the colorful spiritual river.
Thunder!
The perfect level of thunderous sword intent lingers in the sword's edge.
Qin Yi cut into this long river of colorful spiritual light with a sword.
Shit!
Qin Hanshuang's colorful spiritual silk was split directly from the middle by Qin Yi's sword.
Qin Hanshuang's expression changed drastically.
Such a powerful move of hers was resolved by Qin Yi, and her spiritual weapon was also destroyed.
Seeing Qin Yi still rushing towards him at top speed.
Qin Hanshuang gritted her teeth and sacrificed her second spiritual weapon. A shield flew out from her storage ring and faced the storm. In the blink of an eye, the shield was like a hill, blocking Qin Yi's face.
After taking out the shield, Qin Hanshuang pulled out countless afterimages with his hands and fingers, forming seals at an astonishing speed.
As long as the shield can resist Qin Yi for a moment, she can perform a set of extremely lethal secret techniques.
"Boom!"
But Qin Hanshuang never expected that the mountain-like shield she offered would be exploded by Qin Yi's sword in an instant!
Before Qin Hanshuang was ready to use the technique, Qin Yi rushed in front of her with a sword.
Qin Hanshuang could only wave her hands in a hurry, and pieces of light spilled out from her fingertips, but these pieces of light were in vain, like thin paper in front of Qin Yi's sword.
Qin Yi's sword edge fell with a swipe.
"Ah!"
Qin Hanshuang let out a scream, her chest was split open, blood spurted out, and her body flew backwards.
Qin Yi was faster and pursued him, thrusting his sword straight.
"Poof!"
A sword pierced Qin Hanshuang's abdomen.
Qin Hanshuang screamed again.
